role: Graduate civil engineer or civil draftsperson - expression of interest (Melbourne)

subject: Speculative enquiry: graduate civil engineer or civil design, Marc Masarate
email_body:
Hello,

This is a speculative enquiry, not a reply to an advertised vacancy. Your careers page invites graduate civil engineers and draftspersons to email an introduction and CV, so I am writing about graduate civil engineering or civil design work in Melbourne.

In February 2026 I finished an Advanced Diploma of Civil Construction Design, with road, earthworks, pavement and stormwater design in Civil 3D and AutoCAD. I also hold a Bachelor of Science in Civil Engineering (Philippines, 2019). From 2019 to 2020 I worked on site in the Philippines as a project-in-charge engineer and then a field engineer on residential subdivision finishing works. I am Melton based, hold a White Card, a driver's licence and my own transport, and have full working rights until December 2027 on a Subclass 485 visa.

Your estate work on drainage, retarding basins and roads is the kind of land development design I want to learn. My drafting so far is from study, not a paid role, so mentoring is what I am looking for.

Would you keep me in mind for a graduate or design support role, or have a short chat? I've attached my resume and cover letter.

Kind regards,
Marc Darenz Masarate
0478 764 077
macdarenz@gmail.com
https://macdarenz-droid.github.io/Portfolio
